regime_context: The TSX momentum ranks are led by Base Metals & Copper (score 1.78, durable, not crowded), with Silver & Gold close behind. The absolute-trend gate is passing for most themes, and rotation breadth is broad but no directional handoff is confirmed. The gate has helped control drawdown historically on this market.
emerging_watch: Silver & Royalties (proxy XGD.TO) is the closest challenger. Watch for its momentum score to close the gap to Base Metals to within 0.2 while maintaining durability above 0.7. Retire watch if the margin widens beyond 0.6 again or durability falls below 0.5.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals is the unambiguous momentum leader with perfect breadth, durable trend health, and no crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate is supportive, providing the only validated edge – better drawdown/shake-out protection. A conditional overweight is sensible, but this is not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: A sharp global industrial slowdown or a copper-price reversal on rising inventories could unwind this leadership quickly, and the momentum rank itself has no forward return-forecasting edge.
